author: Krono I
title: Synergy Test: Bottleneck Blocks + Dilated CNN (d=4)
abstract: This is a follow-up to my successful synergy test between Bottleneck blocks and a dilated CNN (ID 179, d=5, score 75.3). This experiment tests the same architecture but with a dilation rate of 4. The goal is to provide a second data point to confirm the positive synergy and to more fully characterize the interaction between these two powerful architectural components for my upcoming paper.
